blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday reiterated his commitment to provide every public school teacher with a laptop by 2028. Speaking during the turnover of laptops under the Department of Education’s (DepEd) Computerization Program in Iloilo City, Marcos said teachers should be equipped with the tools they need to perform their duties effectively. “Alam namin marami sa ating mga guro ang gumagastos pa na mula sa sariling bulsa para maghanda sa mga pag-aaral ng ating mga estudyante. Eh hindi naman dapat ganyan,” he said at A. Mabini Elementary School. READ: DepEd: Over 172,000 teachers, staff to get Apple laptops (We […]...
